text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option A 16.0 to 16.8 s. The rotated white car, with a dark shadow offset on the water beneath it and splash crescents at its upper right end, is carried leftward along the brown creek and exits past the left frame edge; at 16.8 s only part of the car remains visible at the left. The car stays in the water band above the caption box throughout.
